disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.en: Checked build artifacts (lib/index.js, lib/client.js) for credential-reading calls. No readFileSync/readFile patterns pointing to sensitive paths were found.

checked_items.en: Checked the install scripts (package.json has no install/preinstall/postinstall/prepare scripts) and the build script (build.mjs). No credential enumeration commands were found.

checked_items.en: Checked all source code for enumeration semantics of sensitive assets such as cloud credentials, wallets, mnemonic phrases, etc. No such patterns were found.

evidence.en: The plugin does not read any credential files or sensitive paths. The only file operation in the source is existsSync in resolve.ts (checking whether the editor executable exists), which does not involve credential file paths. The plugin makes no network requests, so there is no credential exfiltration channel.

checked_items.en: Checked all tool registration surfaces: contributes.tools in dsh.plugin.json is an empty array, no ctx.tools.register call is found in the code, and the plugin registers no tools.

checked_items.en: Checked the service description text in the Typert manifest (src/typert.ts). The only description is "Open one workspace directory in the configured editor CLI.", which is semantically normal with no misleading wording.

checked_items.en: Checked the system prompt injection surface: no ctx.systemPrompt.section call was found.

checked_items.en: Checked all source code and documentation for instruction-override wording, system message impersonation, approval bypass patterns, etc. No such text was found.

checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin references dynamic package tools like cordis_define/cordis_run. No such calls were found.

evidence.en: cordis.patch.yml contains only pure insert directives, with no executable YAML scalars such as !!js or !!js/function. There is no patch-as-RCE risk.

evidence.zh: 源代码中未引用 cordis_define/cordis_run 等动态包工具，不存在 self-modification 滥用途径。
evidence.en: The source code does not reference dynamic package tools such as cordis_define/cordis_run, so there is no avenue for self-modification abuse.

evidence.en: The plugin declares dsh.client (web platform), but the client bundle only renders workspace menu rows and does not include privileged RPC calls such as keyboard listening, clipboard access, or credentials.set.

evidence.en: The plugin makes no network requests (no fetch/http/WebSocket calls in either src or lib), so there is no outbound data channel. The credential reading surface has already been confirmed absent in DG-D1.

checked_items.en: Checked package.json dependencies: the only runtime dependency is zod ^4.4.3 (a well-known npm package), and peerDependencies are the @deepseek-ai/dsh-* ecosystem packages. No suspicious dependencies were found.

evidence.en: cordis.patch.yml contains only insert directives, does not touch security config sections such as sandbox/approval/permission, and does not contain disabled or mode downgrade syntax.

summary.en: Static scan passed: all 12 mechanical rule hits were individually adjudicated as benign (see the audit scope limitations section), and no suspicious patterns requiring escalation to vulnerability findings were found.

limits.zh:
未做动态沙箱验证（L4 未启用），静态分析范围有限。插件 manifest 不含显式能力声明段，declared_capabilities 中 shell:true 系按代码实测推断（实际启动编辑器进程），其余能力清零。构建产物 lib/index.js（约 582KB）与 lib/client.js（约 552KB）因体积超限仅部分读取/扫描；lib/*.js.map 为 esbuild 自动生成的源码映射，未逐行通读，但静态扫描规则已覆盖全部文件。12 条机械预扫命中逐条裁决如下：

(1) DSH-X10/DG-R2-57 @ AGENTS.md:1 — AGENTS.md 存在，内容为插件架构描述性文档，无注入指令，良性排除。
(2) DSH-X03/DG-R3-55 @ build.mjs:61 — 构建脚本中的 execFileSync 调用 tsc，构建时专用，不随安装/运行时执行，良性排除。
(3) DSH-X08/DG-R3-60 @ lib/client.js:4454 — zod v4 阿拉伯语语言包的 Unicode 转义字符串，属第三方依赖国际化数据，非混淆，良性排除。
(4) DSH-X08/DG-R3-60 @ lib/client.js.map:3 — 源码映射文件长行，esbuild 自动生成，良性排除。
(5) DSH-X08/DG-R3-60 @ lib/client.js.map:4 — 源码映射 sourcesContent 内嵌源码，转义密度来自原始代码，良性排除。
(6) DSH-X03/DG-R3-55 @ lib/index.js:304 — bundled schemastery 库的 Schema 构造函数中 new Function 将字符串回调转为函数，schema 选项为编译时常量，非用户输入可控，良性排除。
(7) DSH-X03/DG-R3-55 @ lib/index.js:867 — spawn 导入是插件核心功能（启动编辑器 CLI），用途声明明确，良性排除。
(8) DSH-X08/DG-R3-60 @ lib/index.js:5391 — zod v4 阿拉伯语语言包，与 lib/client.js 同源，良性排除。
(9) DSH-X03/DG-R3-55 @ lib/index.js.map:4 — 源码映射中反映 schemastery 的 new Function 行，生成产物，良性排除。
(10) DSH-X08/DG-R3-60 @ lib/index.js.map:3 — 源码映射文件长行，同 lib/client.js.map，良性排除。
(11) DSH-X08/DG-R3-60 @ lib/index.js.map:4 — 源码映射 sourcesContent 转义密度，同 lib/client.js.map，良性排除。
(12) DSH-X03/DG-R3-55 @ src/runtime.ts:9 — spawn 导入，核心功能，良性排除。
limits.en:
Dynamic sandbox verification was not performed (L4 not enabled), so the static analysis scope is limited. The plugin manifest does not contain an explicit capability declaration section; declared_capabilities has shell:true inferred from actual code behavior (it actually launches an editor process), with all other capabilities zeroed. Build artifacts lib/index.js (~582KB) and lib/client.js (~552KB) were only partially read/scanned due to size limits; lib/*.js.map are source maps auto-generated by esbuild and were not read line-by-line, but static scan rules covered all files. The 12 mechanical pre-scan hits were adjudicated individually as follows:

(1) DSH-X10/DG-R2-57 @ AGENTS.md:1 — AGENTS.md exists, content is a descriptive architecture document for the plugin, no injection instructions, benign and excluded.
(2) DSH-X03/DG-R3-55 @ build.mjs:61 — execFileSync in the build script invokes tsc, used only at build time, not executed at install/runtime, benign and excluded.
(3) DSH-X08/DG-R3-60 @ lib/client.js:4454 — Unicode escape string from the zod v4 Arabic language pack, third-party dependency internationalization data, not obfuscation, benign and excluded.
(4) DSH-X08/DG-R3-60 @ lib/client.js.map:3 — long line in source map file, auto-generated by esbuild, benign and excluded.
(5) DSH-X08/DG-R3-60 @ lib/client.js.map:4 — sourcesContent in source map embeds original source, escape density comes from original code, benign and excluded.
(6) DSH-X03/DG-R3-55 @ lib/index.js:304 — in the bundled schemastery library, new Function in the Schema constructor converts string callbacks to functions; schema options are compile-time constants, not user-input controlled, benign and excluded.
(7) DSH-X03/DG-R3-55 @ lib/index.js:867 — the spawn import is the plugin's core functionality (launching the editor CLI), usage purpose is clear, benign and excluded.
(8) DSH-X08/DG-R3-60 @ lib/index.js:5391 — zod v4 Arabic language pack, same origin as lib/client.js, benign and excluded.
(9) DSH-X03/DG-R3-55 @ lib/index.js.map:4 — reflects the schemastery new Function line in the source map, generated artifact, benign and excluded.
(10) DSH-X08/DG-R3-60 @ lib/index.js.map:3 — long line in source map file, same as lib/client.js.map, benign and excluded.
(11) DSH-X08/DG-R3-60 @ lib/index.js.map:4 — sourcesContent escape density in source map, same as lib/client.js.map, benign and excluded.
(12) DSH-X03/DG-R3-55 @ src/runtime.ts:9 — spawn import, core functionality, benign and excluded.
